def process(msa_fraud_2024, florida_msa_fraud) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    def tidy_msa(df):
        # first row with 'Rank' indicates header row
        header_idx = df.index[df.iloc[:,0].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Rank')]
        if len(header_idx)==0:
            header_idx = df.index[df.iloc[:,0].astype(str).str.contains('Metropolitan Area', na=False)]
        hi = int(header_idx[0])
        cols = df.iloc[hi].tolist()
        out = df.iloc[hi+1:].copy()
        out.columns = cols
        out = out.dropna(how='all')
        return out

    metro = tidy_msa(msa_fraud_2024)
    # ensure expected columns
    metro = metro.rename(columns={
        '# of Reports':'reports',
        'Metropolitan Area':'metro_area'
    })
    metro['metro_area'] = metro['metro_area'].astype(str).str.strip()
    metro['reports'] = pd.to_numeric(metro['reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',','', regex=False), errors='coerce')

    fl = florida_msa_fraud.copy()
    # header row where first col == 'Metropolitan Area'
    h2 = fl.index[fl.iloc[:,0].astype(str).str.strip().eq('Metropolitan Area')]
    hi2 = int(h2[0])
    fl2 = fl.iloc[hi2+1:].copy()
    fl2.columns = ['metro_area','reports']
    fl2 = fl2.dropna(how='all')
    fl2['metro_area'] = fl2['metro_area'].astype(str).str.strip()
    fl2['reports'] = pd.to_numeric(fl2['reports'].astype(str).str.replace(',','', regex=False), errors='coerce')

    target = 'Miami-Fort Lauderdale-West Palm Beach, FL Metropolitan Statistical Area'
    m1 = metro[metro['metro_area'].eq(target)][['metro_area','reports']].rename(columns={'reports':'reports_us_metro_file'})
    m2 = fl2[fl2['metro_area'].eq(target)][['metro_area','reports']].rename(columns={'reports':'reports_florida_file'})
    out = m1.merge(m2, on='metro_area', how='outer')
    out['consistent'] = out['reports_us_metro_file'].fillna(-1).eq(out['reports_florida_file'].fillna(-2))
    return out
